gaps: Voters' pamphlet statement not readable: the individual statement PDF in the county's Military & Overseas Online Voters' Guide is a scan with no machine-readable text, and the full and large-print county pamphlet PDFs are cut off by the fetch tool (~105k characters) before the City of Portland section (pp. M-52 to M-66)
Did not respond to the Portland Tribune candidate Q&A
No voting record (has not held elected office)

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. The pamphlet index lists a statement for this candidate, but the collector could not read it. The pamphlet PDF text is 104,260 characters and ends before the Portland section (M-53 to M-60), and the individual statement scan is not linked from the MOO guide page and could not be re-fetched. This is a source-access gap, confirmed. The form is readable and its website (tomforpdx.com) is confirmed. Missed material: a BikePortland interview dated 2026-02-20 ('Meet District 3 City Council Candidate Tom Sollitt'). The 'did not respond to Tribune' gap is confirmed. Incumbent=false confirmed.
